items.title: Virginia Mayhew interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 23, 2022
items.q: and then Ingrid Jensen, Roberta Pickett, Victor Jones. I mean I get to play with all these people

ctx.x: Well I mean Sonny Rollins, Coltrane, Dexter Gordon, Joe Henderson, Lester Young, Kenny Garrett, Cannonball, Bird, and then Ingrid Jensen, Roberta Pickett, Victor Jones. I mean I get to play with all these people and they’re such great musicians and they
continue to grow and I just I think they’re inspiring you know and the music moves on. Coltrane’s been dead how many decades? You know George Garzone, I love George Garzone. Do you know him?
